title: video.participant.joined
description: A connection joined a call: the opening half of a presence span. Ids and timestamps only — no display name and no email travel on the bus; a subscriber that needs one asks the profile side by user_id. joined_at is the MEDIA SERVER's timestamp, not the moment we received the webhook. connection_id is the per-browser half of the provider identity {user_id}_{client_session_id}: one person on a laptop and a phone is one user_id and two connection_ids, which is why presence time is unioned per user rather than summed per connection. Emitted once per span this instance created — a redelivered provider webhook is deduplicated on (connection_id, joined_at) and emits nothing.
